subject.title: feat(android): add Wear conversations, voice, agents, and sessions

question: Should a paired same-signature Wear OS app be authorized to read recent transcripts, submit messages, and change the phone runtime's active agent and session without a separate in-product approval step?
rationale: Tests can validate protocol mechanics, but they cannot decide whether pairing alone is the intended authorization boundary for transcript and session-changing operations.

options.title: Approve paired-watch authorization
options.body: Treat a paired same-signature watch as authorized, document the boundary, and verify deterministic phone selection when multiple nodes are reachable.

options.title: Require explicit phone approval
options.body: Add an in-product phone opt-in or per-watch authorization before exposing transcripts and authenticated actions.

options.title: Limit the watch surface
options.body: Keep Wear read-only or status-focused and omit conversation, agent, and session mutation operations.

recommendation.title: Approve paired-watch authorization
recommendation.body: Treat a paired same-signature watch as authorized, document the boundary, and verify deterministic phone selection when multiple nodes are reachable.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly assigns ownership of the Android app and its permission/security posture to this person.
